# rediscloud_iris_identity_provider (Resource)

Manages a direct Iris identity resource, independently of Redis Cloud CAPI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rediscloud_iris_identity_provider" "example" {
  tenant              = "your-tenant"
  name                = "Corporate"
  issuer              = "https://issuer.example.com"
  audience            = "api://redis-iris"
  jwks_uri            = "https://issuer.example.com/.well-known/jwks.json"
  required_algorithms = ["RS256"]
  token_exchange_json = jsonencode({
    grants        = "SUBJECT_GRANTS"
    irisAudiences = ["api://redis-iris"]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `audience` (String) The one aud value that a token must have. The usual value is api://redis-iris, or the application ID on Entra ID.
- `issuer` (String) The iss of the tokens of the IdP.
- `jwks_uri` (String) The https URL of the key set of the IdP.
- `name` (String) The name of a record: a letter, and then up to 63 letters, digits, "_", or "-" (MOD-20320 R3).
- `tenant` (String) A tenant identifier as in TenantId, without "/" and without a space at its ends, and not "." or "..", because the tenant is a part of the path.

### Optional

- `required_algorithms` (List of String) The signing algorithms to accept. The default is RS256.
- `token_exchange_json` (String) JSON-encoded service configuration. Use jsonencode(...). How the token exchange uses the tokens of an IdP (MOD-19927). The token exchange names the entry <tenant>:<name>.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier used for import.
- `revision` (String) The revision of the record. Each change writes a new value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import rediscloud_iris_identity_provider.example your-tenant/Corporate
```
